text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅11日同美国国务卿鲁比奥通电话。双方就中美关系及两国元首互动深入交换意见，通话是积极和建设性的。 王毅表示，习近平主席9月访美顺利、成功，两国元首一致同意丰富中美关系新定位的内涵，为探索中美正确相处之道提供了更加明确的战略指引。中美关系稳定势头来之不易，是两个大国从各自和共同利益出发作出的理性选择。中国对美政策保持稳定性和连续性，愿同美方加强沟通合作，妥善处理分歧和敏感问题，相互支持办好2026年亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议和二十国集团领导人峰会，推动中美建设性战略稳定关系落地见效。（新华社）
text_en: Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke by phone with US Secretary of State Rubio on the 11th. The two sides had in-depth exchanges on China-US relations and interactions between the two heads of state, and the call was positive and constructive. Wang Yi said President Xi Jinping's September visit to the US was smooth and successful, and the two heads of state agreed to enrich the connotation of the new positioning of China-US relations, providing clearer strategic guidance for exploring the right way for the two countries to get along. The stable momentum in China-US relations has not come easily and is a rational choice made by the two major countries based on their respective and common interests. China's policy toward the US maintains stability and continuity, and China is willing to strengthen communication and cooperation with the US, properly handle differences and sensitive issues, and support each other in hosting the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and the G20 Leaders' Summit, so as to translate the constructive strategic stability relationship between China and the US into concrete results. (Xinhua)
